Pavitra Shankar: 
Thank you. Good afternoon, everyone, and thanks for joining us for Brigade Enterprises Q2 
FY27 Earnings Call. I'm joined by our Joint Managing Director, Ms. Nirupa Shankar; and our 
Executive Directors, Mr. Amar Mysore and Mr. Pradyumna Krishna Kumar; and our CFO, Mr. 
Yogesh Patel. We will jump right in. 
 
In Real Estate, we launched 2.4 million square feet of residential projects in Q2 at an estimated 
GDV of approximately INR3,000 crores. Brigade Barcelona at Neopolis in Hyderabad had a 
good customer response with launch quarter sales of INR475 crores. Brigade Misty Greens in 
Mysuru was a launch that slipped into Q2, yet we have almost completely sold the available 
inventory. A small senior-friendly project, Azalea at Brigade Meadows in Bengaluru rounded 
out the quarter's launches. 
 
Net sales for the quarter were INR 1,827 Cr on a volume of 1.32 million square feet, 72% and 
78% higher than Q1 value and area, respectively. While presales was 10% lower than Q2 FY26, 
this is mostly reflective of the launch timing this year and not of the demand on ground. Average 
realization stood at INR13,841 per square foot, a strong 29% year-on-year improvement, driven 
by disciplined pricing increases in our existing projects and a sustained shift in contribution of 
higher-end homes in our overall product mix. 
 
While the RBI raised repo rates by 25 bps after a long period of stable rates, this has not impacted 
customer sentiment on ground as the share of our customer taking home loans continues to hold 
steady. 
 
Two thirds of residential volume in the quarter came from sustenance sales in our ongoing 
projects with the balance from new launches. We have INR9,800 crores of inventory in addition 
to another 7 million square feet or INR7,600 crores Gross Developmental Value (GDV) of 
launches planned for the second half of the financial year. In Q3, we aim to launch two of our 
large township projects in Bengaluru, which both have significant contributions to the H2 sales 
achievements. For now, we reiterate the INR9,000 crores presales guidance.

Our commercial office portfolio continued to grow steadily. During Q2, we added 0.27 million 
square feet to our operational leasing portfolio with the completion of Brigade Square in 
Trivandrum, a 185,000 square feet project that's 100% pre-leased. We also completed Arcadia 
at Brigade Cornerstone Utopia in Bengaluru, taking our total operational leasing area to 9.6 
million square feet at a portfolio occupancy of 90%. 
 
This quarter, we transacted close to 6 lakh square feet of commercial space, approximately 1 
lakh square feet in sales, 1.5 lakh square feet in new leasing, 2.13 lakh square feet in churned 
space and 1.34 lakh square feet of investor space. Rental collections remained robust at 99% and 
office-only lease revenue stood at INR201 crores, 8% higher year-on-year. 
 
Our occupier base remains well diversified across GCCs, IT, ITES, BFSI, engineering, life 
sciences and flexible workspace operators. Occupier demand continues to reflect a flight to 
quality with GCCs accounting for 41% of Q2 office leasing and green certified tech parks 
capturing 61% of market absorption. In line with this, three of our assets, WTC Annexe, Brigade 
Twin Towers and Brigade Deccan Heights received IGBC Gold certification during the quarter. 
 
Lease-up of WTC Bengaluru and Brigade Twin Towers remain our priority for the coming 
quarters, and both projects have a healthy pipeline. Beyond our operating portfolio, we have 6.8 
million square feet of commercial development under construction, including the World Trade 
Center and Orion Mall in Hyderabad with balance capital expenditure of approximately 
INR3,350 crores to complete this pipeline. We will continue to phase new supply in line with 
occupier demand. 
 
Turning to retail. Our Orion Mall portfolio delivered a steady quarter at 94% trading occupancy. 
Retailer sales across the portfolio grew 16% year-on-year, led by stronger electronics and 
restaurant sales, while mall footfall remained steady, supported by new store openings, festive 
activations, promotional events and major movie releases. We're also premiumizing the lower 
ground floor at Orion Gateway with bridge-to-luxury brands. 
 
Aureya FM Services, our in-house facility management company now manages 16 million 
square feet with a revenue of INR71 crores and EBITDA of 30% in this quarter. In Hospitality, 
BHVL delivered a strong Q2. Portfolio Average Room Revenue (ARR) grew 11% year-on-year 
to INR7,876 and RevPAR grew 10% year-on-year to INR5,922 at an occupancy of 75%. 
 
Bengaluru remains a key growth market with occupancy of 81% and RevPAR growth of 12%. 
BHVL's PAT more than doubled to INR22 crores from a year ago, aided by lower finance costs 
following the post-IPO debt repayment and improved operating performance. Growth has been 
rate-led with resilient domestic demand. 
 
Q2 was also a strong quarter for our ESG on both performance and recognition. We achieved a 
GRESB Real Estate ESG score of 93.7 with a 4-Star rating for FY26, reflecting our steady 
progress towards the sustainability goals. 
 
Brigade Citrine received the IGBC Net Zero Carbon (Design) certification with 76 credit points, 
extending our net zero approach from individual landmark project to how we design the wider 
portfolio.

The EBITDA margin improved to 38% compared with 26% in Q2 of FY26, an improvement of 
1,200 basis points. This improvement builds further upon our performance of Q1 FY27 and is 
primarily contributed by higher margins in the Real Estate segment. Detailing the segment-wise 
performance in the quarter, the Real Estate segment reported a revenue of INR760 crores and an 
EBITDA of Rs. 178 crores, with EBITDA increasing by 62% as compared to Q2 of FY26. The 
EBITDA margin grew 2x year-on-year to 24% versus 12% in Q2 FY26. 
 
The Leasing segment revenue of INR329 crores was consistent with the previous quarter of this 
year, while on a year-on-year basis, it decreased by 3%. It is pertinent to note that Q2 FY26 
included a onetime income of around INR26 crores related to a finance lease transaction. 
Excluding this, the revenue for Q2 FY27 would be higher by 4% year-on-year. 
 
EBITDA for Leasing segment, including facility management, stood at INR242 crores, an 
EBITDA margin of 73%. The Hospitality segment clocked a turnover of INR161 crores in Q2 
FY27 with an EBITDA of INR59 crores, a growth of 41% year on year. EBITDA margin for 
the segment was 37% for the quarter, a growth of 700 basis points over Q2 FY26. Consolidated 
PAT for the group stood at INR219 crores at 18% and year-on-year growth of 29%. PAT after 
minority interest for Q2 FY27 stands at INR194 crores. 
 
In the quarter, as Pavitra highlighted earlier, we saw completion of 2 leasing facilities, adding 
about 2.7 lakh square feet of leasing space. A large part of delta increase that you notice in the 
depreciation line item of our P&L in the quarter is contributed by this. 
 
Touching upon cash flow performance. Collections for the quarter stood at INR1,633 crores. 
The reduction in collection number as compared to earlier quarters was primarily due to 
milestone that got billed in the third month of the quarter and for which collections were in 
progress. This is also reflected in higher trade receivables number in the balance sheet. 
 
Net cash flow from operating activities stood at INR246 crores. We remain confident of 
sustaining healthy cash flows in the coming quarters and outlook to generate operating cash flow 
from operations for the entire financial year higher than that of FY26, in line with the segment 
performances. 
 
To give a segment view of the collections in this quarter, Real Estate segment contributed 
INR1,115 crores, Leasing segment, INR343 crores and Hospitality segment, INR175 crores.
